description: machine-readable contract for the same-audio cross-evaluator comparisons (PER and Q3O), shared by the CUDA runbooks and the RC6 comparators

audio_identity.hard_requirement: per-file SHA256 equality of the exact evaluation audio (MP3 for PER, MP3 for Q3O); same-song-different-encode is a REJECT

per_comparison_fields: selection changes (four explicit fields: changed_prompt_count, removed_candidate_count, added_candidate_count, selection_symmetric_difference_count)
micro PER (sum(edits)/sum(reference_phonemes)), macro PER, zh/en strata
paired bootstrap 95% CI (prompt-level resampling, 10k draws, seed 1234)
q3o_comparison_fields: judge identity (both sides: model revision, file hashes, prompts, parser, scorer)
paired bootstrap 95% CI on mean delta
per-candidate paired rows (overall + every dimension + weights)
tie-break disclosure (~18-20% routed slots at exact ties; official rule unpublished)

equivalence_criteria_rules.preregistration: criteria MUST be fixed by the protocol owner/author BEFORE the CUDA run; file format: {'criteria': [{'kind': ..., thresholds...}]}
equivalence_criteria_rules.comparator_never_decides: the comparator applies the file verbatim; without a file the verdict is PENDING_CRITERIA
equivalence_criteria_rules.post_hoc_forbidden: criteria chosen after seeing results are invalid by construction

verdicts.pilot_rule: a diagnostic-subset result NEVER scales to full-set equivalence; both reported separately

tools.attribution_update: scripts/rc6_per_paired_attribution.py (adds the official column after a real CUDA run)
